tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i rnam thar snying por dril ba bzhugs so/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i bdag/dpal ldan bla mar gus btud
༄༅/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i rnam thar snying por dril ba bzhugs so/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i bdag/dpal ldan bla mar gus btud

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i rnam thar snying por dril ba bzhugs so// dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i bdag /dpal ldan bla mar gus btud nas/ /rang tshul sgro skur ma mchis par/ /dam pa'i gsung ngor mdor bsdus brjod/ /kho bo bod chen sde dge'i shar/ /gter lhung zhes pa'i sa yi char/ /khyung chen brag gi 'dabs rol tu/ /gnyos kyi rigs su grags pa las/ /rab yid lcags pho 'brug gi lo'i/ /dbyar tha chu stod zla ba yi/ /chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus tshes dang*/ /nye ba dkar phyogs rdzogs pa'i nyin/ /ngo mtshar ltas bcas btsas so skad/ /dran tsam dus su ye shes kyi/ /mgon po phyag drug e ka dzas/ /yang yang brtse zhing skyong ba dang*/ /tshe sngon bag chags 'al 'ol dran/ /chung nas rab byung phyogs su bsnyen/ /nyer gcig lo yi gung son tshe/ /smin grol chos kyi gling chen por/ /brtan mkhas rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i bshes/ /rig 'dzin bzang por bsnyen par rdzogs/ /khri chen sangs rgyas kun dga' las/ /dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed dang*/ /dpal chen yang dag so lugs dang*/ /rig 'dzin thugs tig dbang bskur nos/ /sdom pa gsum dang ldan par byas/ /snga phyir khams dbus gtsang gsum du/ /mi lo bcu gsum thos pa btsal/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang dge ba'i bshes/ /rig byed gzhung la mkhas pa sogs/ /gtsug nor brgya dang lnga bcu bsten/ /bzo gso sgra tshad yan lag bcas/ /'dul mdzod dbu phar bshad srol thos/ /gsar rnying rdo rje theg pa yi/ /dbang dang byin rlabs rjes gnang sogs/ /bka' gter bka' gdams sa skya pa/ /'bri stag mtshur dang gdan 'brug gi/ /sngon gyi lugs srol ma nyams par/ /bzhugs pa'i smin grol gdams ngag dang*/ /bde dgyes gsang gsum dus 'khor lo/ /sgyu 'khrul gsang ba snying po sogs/ /rgyab rten rgyud ky-i bshad pa dang*/ /bka' bstan dam pa'i gsung rab lung*/ /glegs bam bdun brgya lhag tsam nyan/

/mdor na bshad rgyud shing rta bcu'i/ /ring lugs rgyun bzhugs phal cher thos/ /cung zad sbyangs shing phyogs tsam shes/ /rang gzhan grub mtha'i khas len dang*/ /chos rgyus shin tu che ba byung*/ /thos pas de rnams phal cher zhig /yang nas yang du 'chad pa dang*/ /lan re ma 'chad med pa ltar/ /dam pa'i skyes bu mchog rnams dang*/ /phal pa mu to yan chad la/ /nyin mtshan chos sbyin ci nus spel/ /bstan pa'i rgyun tsam 'byung re ba'i/ /lhag bsam smon pa snying nas bgyis/ /gser zangs 'ba' zhig las grub pa'i/ /sku rten stong phrag gnyis tsam dang*/ /khyad par gsung rten glegs bam ni/ /pusti bzhi bcu nye ba'i spar/ /bris dang spar la bsdoms pa yi/ /glegs bam stong phrag gnyis tsam bzhengs/ /de rnams bzhugs pa'i lha khang khag /bcu gsum tsam zhig bkod mdzes bskrun/ /thugs rten mchod sdong chen mos gtsos/ /gser zangs las grub brgya phrag lhag /bzhengs shing ci nus mchod 'bul bgyis/ /gnas gzhi gsar du bzhengs pa ni/ /dus kyi mthar 'khyol dka' bas na/ /bskrun pa'i rtsol ba ma mchis kyang*/ /phyogs 'dir stod smad 'khrugs long gis/ /dgon gnas phal cher nyams pa rnams/ /rgya bod chos rgyal sde dge bcas/ /dpon blon rnams kyi rgyud bskul nas/ /nyams gsos zhal 'debs zhal bskos dang*/ /rang ngos mdzub mgo'i mchod pa'i dpes/ /dngos ja sum stong lhag pa phul/ /phal cher gsar bzhengs nyams gso sogs/ /tshags su tshud pa'i bya ba bsgrub/ /phan tshun chos kyi sde rnams su/ /lo re bzhin du yon sbyar nas/ /gzungs sngags bsngo ba smon lam rten/ /snga rjes dngos ja bzhi stong gi/ /rtsa ba nyams pa med phul nas/ /'brel tshad don ldan smon pa bgyis/ /sa kar rnying ma dge lugs kyi/ /bstan 'dzin skyes mchog dam pa sogs/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtha' yas dang*/ /rgya bod dpon chen gtsor gyur pa'i/ /'dus pa tshad bzung med pa la/

/chos kyi mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ /rkyen sel dbang dang byin rlabs sogs/ /blo sna sun sun re ba bskangs/ /gong ma'i yul rnams thams cad la/ /ci nus mchod pa'i sprin yang spros/ /rang nyid grub mtha' gang la yang*/ /gus shing dad pa ma gtogs pa/ /log rtogs cung zad med pa'i mthus/ /g.yung drung bon lugs tshun chod kyi/ /slob 'brel rgya che mu med byung*/ /spong ba bsam gtan de kho nar/ /mnyam par 'jog pa dka' na yang*/ /chung nas gdul bya grong chog sogs/ /rmi lam du yang ma dran cing*/ /tshe 'di blo yis thongs pa yis/ /bya btang kho na'i tshul du 'khums/ /mchog dman su la'ang ngo srung dang*/ /re dog spros pa dmar thag bcad/ /snga phyi mi lo bcu gsum tsam/ /lhag pa'i lha yi bsnyen sgrub dang*/ /zab khrid brgya rtsa shar sgom bgyis/ /nyams dang rtogs pas dben mod kyang*/ /khas blangs cha tsam bsgrubs pa yis/ /snyigs dus skal bzang gral tshud tsam/ /byung bas yid bde 'ba' zhig shar/ /de ltar 'khor lo rnam gsum gyi/ /phyi yi rnam thar mdor bsdus so/ /nang gi rnam par thar pa ni/ /snga 1 'gyur bka' bdams 2 sa skya pa 3/ /mar shangs bka' brgyud 4 sbyor ba drug 5/ /zhi gcod 6 bsnyen 7 sgrub 8 dang bcas pa'i*/ /sgrub brgyud shing rta che brgyad la/ /shin tu mos shing dad pa'i blos/ /sngon gyi lugs srol ma nyams pa/ /dka' ba 'bad pa brgya phrag gis/ /mang du tshol zhing thos par byas/ /de lta'i thos bsam sgom pa'i skabs/ /dngos nyams rmi lam ci rigs par/ /bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro yis/ /nye brgyud gdams pa stsal ba dang*/ /byin brlabs mtshan ma ci yang mthong*/ /dngos grub thob pa dka' mod kyi/ /tshig don sgom tshul phal cher zhig /shes shing khong du chud pa byung*/ /'on kyang gzhan blor shongs dka' bas/ /mdo tsam yin gyi rgyas par ni/ /brjod kyis mi longs dgos pa bskyung*/ /re zhig nang gi rnam thar gyi/

/sa bon tsam du smos pa'o/ /gsang ba bka' babs bdun 'byung zhes/ /o rgyan chen po'i lung byang las/ /yang yang bsngags par mdzad pa ltar/ /rang lo brgyad pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /'du 'khrugs drag pos mnar ba na/ /padma thod phreng yab yum gyis/ /rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur byin brlabs gegs las grol/ /bco lnga'i dus su nying 'khrul dang*/ /mngon sum gang yin 'byed dka' ba'i/ /nyams kyi gsal snang brtan pa la/ /rgya gar badzra ā sa na'i/ /ke'u tshang dgu rim drung du sleb/ /rim gyis 'dzegs nas brgyad pa'i nang*/ /slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen ni/ /g.yas g.yon glegs bam dang bcas pa/ /paṇḍi ta yi tshul du mjal/ /gus pas btud cing gsol btab pas/ /thog mar g.yon gyi glegs bam nyid/ /sher phyin sdud pa'i rgya dper snang*/ /de nyid spyi bor bkod nas kyang*/ /mtshan nyid chos kyi bka' lung gi/ /byin rlabs rdzogs pa yin no gsungs/ /g.yas kyi glegs bam rdzogs pa che/ /rdor sems snying gi me long gis/ /byin brlabs sngags kyi tshul spyi dang*/ /sde gsum rdzogs pa chen po yi/ /tshig don byin rlabs rdzogs par stsal/ /lung bstan 'ga' zhig mdzad pa'i mthar/ /dgyes pas 'od zhu rang la thim/ /rtog med ngang du dar cig lus/ /phyir 'ong sgo drung me chen por/ /'bar ba'i nang du dbang med zhugs/ /rags pa'i lus phung bsregs pa'i mod/ /bi ma mi tra yin snyam pa'i/ /'od kyi lus su lam mer snang*/ /gzhan yang grub thob thang stong sogs/ /mang pos rjes su bzung ba dang*/ /dbang dang byin rlabs thob pa sogs/ /grub chen snying gi thig ler bsdus/ /bcu drug sa zla'i tshes bcu yi/ /tho rangs padma 'od du sleb/ /de yang spyir btang bkod pa dang*/ /mi mthun brag ri lhun chags phug /sprin dkar shin tu mdzes pa'i khrod/ /mtsho skyes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas mjal/ /dgongs pas byin brlabs brda dbang bstsal/

/bka' babs bdun gyi dbugs dbyung thob/ /de mthar lta stangs dang bcas te/ /gzung ba'i yul gyis ma gos shing*/ /'dzin pa'i rtog pas ma bslad par/ rig stong rjen par bskyang ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs rang la thim pa yis/ /thugs yid dbyer med 'dres pa'i ngang*/ /gnas lugs rang so zin tsam byung*/ /de la spro ba skyes nas kyang*/ /dad pas rtse gcig gsol btab mthus/ /snga 'gyur bka' ma'i rgyun 1kun thob/ /sa gter 2dngos dang yang 3gter dang*/ /dgongs gter 4dag snang 5snyan brgyud 6sde/ /rjes su 7dran pa'i gter bcas pa'i/ /bka' babs brgyud mar thob pa rnams/ /lo chen bai ro dngos byon pa/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag bka' drin can/ /'dzam gling chos kyi shing rta che/ /'jam mgon blau gros mtha' yas kyis/ /shin tu don gnyer dgongs gtad pas/ /phal cher gtan la phab nas kyang*/ /dgyes pa'i mchod sprin mchog tu spros/ /rin chen gter gyi mdzod chen por/ /rgyab rten legs bshad rmad byung bcas/ /bzhugs su gsol zhing spar du bskrun/ /bsnyen bsgrub 'chad spel mdzad pa yis/ /bgyi ba don dang ldan par gyur/ /gzhan yang ris med skyes chen la/ /ci rigs phul zhing dgyes pa bskyed/ /'di rnams thog mar lung bstan dang*/ /kha byang ji ltar byung ba dang*/ /bar du gtan la phab tshul dang*/ /tha mar 'brel 'jog nyams blangs skabs/ /slob dpon yi dam mkha' 'gro yis/ /dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul/ /shin tu zhib par yod na yang*/ /'ga' zhig chos tshan so so'i skabs/ /zur tsam gsal bas mkhyen bya yi/ /rgyas par spro bar ma nus mod/ /slad nas spro ba'i rten 'brel 'tshal/ /de ltar da lta'i rnam par thar/ /don gyi snying po sa bon tsam/ /mdor bsdus nyid du gsol ba ste/ /snga ma dran pa'i mthu chung yang*/ /gter lung rnams su gsal ba dang*/ /dam pa rnams kyis dman pa la/

/spro ba bskyed phyir dbugs dbyung ba/ /dpal ldan karma pa sogs kyis/ /gsol 'debs tshigs su bcad par gsal/ /rang gi bag chags 'al 'ol tsam/ /rgya gar yul du grub pa'i dbang*/ /rdo rje dril bu pa dang ni/ /sgo mtha' yas pa'i blo gros dang*/ /paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen sogs/ /paṇa grub 'ga' zhig gsal ba dang*/ /bod yul khri srong mchog grub rgyal/ /chos dbang mnga' ris paṇḍi ta/ /thang stong lha btsun chen po sogs/ /'al 'ol dran yang yid rten ci/ /ma 'ongs bi ma'i bla sgrub skabs/ /tshe 'di 'phos ma thag pa nas/ /sprul gzhi ri bo rtse lnga ru/ /pan chen bi ma'i thugs kar thim/ /sprul pa lnga 'byung smon lam mthus/ /ris med bstan par phan ces gsungs/ /de ltar dus gsum rtogs brjod 'di/ /lha sras dam 'dzin skye ba'i mtha'/ /'gran bral grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur/ /'jigs med phrin las 'od zer gyi/ /rnam 'phrul mkhas btsun bzang po'i phul/ /'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma yis/ /lha rdzas rin chen skyes dang bcas/ /nan tan bskul ngo mi ldog tsam/ /shin tu mdor bsdus sa bon du/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris/ /dge bas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /theg mchog bshes dang mi 'bral zhing*/ /myur du byang chub thob par shog /maṅga laṃ//
